scientific.integrity: The powered-softmax identity is substituted into the exact cross-entropy derivative, after which the chain rule reconstructs the full head-and-feature parameter vector field as a scalar surrogate gradient. The SGD conjugacy is then an exact change of variables, not an empirical approximation.
limitations: The network must expose a final linear softmax head \(W h_\theta(x)\).
The exact optimizer conjugacy covers plain full-batch gradient descent and minibatch SGD, not momentum or adaptive-state optimizers.
The fixed-feature max-margin statement is conditional on the standard separable-data assumptions of the cited cross-entropy implicit-bias theorem.

title: PowerGrad is exactly cross-entropy SGD with a reciprocal head–body learning-rate rebalance
